title: Tunneled walkway.
officialText:
Separation between the tunneled walkway and the building to which it is connected shall not be less
than 2-hour fire-resistant construction and openings therein shall be protected in accordance with Table 715.4.
SECTION BC 3105
AWNINGS, CANOPIES AND SUN CONTROL DEVICES
